title: On-Load Briefing Rule
desc: Mandatory briefing read on session load
steps: NAVIGATION: this skill is an entry-point router for session-start behavior, not an always-execute checklist. STOP FORMAT, EVERY FINAL REPLY (owner 2026-10-04): each paragraph is followed by ONE evidence line, wkappbot skill read CORE_SKILL_ID --keep 'a sentence copied from that skill that shares 2 or more words with your paragraph' (or wkappbot file read PATH --keep '...' for CLAUDE.md, REFLEX.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, HANDOFF.md, README.md, SPOKESMAN.md, ROOT.md); read the item and press a like on it first; the LAST paragraph starts with Reflex-healing: (the reflex you did not follow, or none followed wrongly) and has its own evidence line; the gate refuses every time until this holds and every refusal prints a ready example. SPEC FIRST (owner 2026-09-25, mandatory for every ROOT): before building or dispatching a sector, the ROOT itself writes the task spec into the owning skill (the -howto of that tool or guard), then builds from that skill; the spokesman only names the task, to save its tokens for hard problems. A spec kept only in a .tmp note or a chat brief gets re-derived differently next time. REMAINING WORK IS NOT A PARKING LOT (owner 2026-09-25): a letter or escalation lists as remaining ONLY what is blocked on an owner decision or is outside your scope; work that is in scope and unblocked is done NOW, and the words next session must never stand in for it (measured: a Sonnet ROOT wrote Next session must and REMAINING for next session over in-scope items from its first report). WHEN: (A) session start or post-compaction, run steps 1+2 below. (B) user sends exactly 'gg' or 'ggg' (case-insensitive, trim whitespace), run the GG TRIGGER step. (C) user says 'handoff' or 'continue from last session', run the HANDOFF step. (D) user is mid-task or sent a casual greeting, do NOT run the full pipeline. HOW: wkappbot skill read on-load-howto for the exact step sequence and commands for each case. WHY: routing correctly avoids wasting tokens on the full pipeline for casual messages and avoids derailing work already in progress. //why:seat model question handled as a task-sonnet //why:two-day spec merged before the brief-opus //why:will follow: (a) session start or-sonnet

MANDATORY SKILL LOADS (session start / post-compaction only): run both -- (1) wkappbot skill read suggest-workflow (2) wkappbot skill read ask-suggest-priority-batching. If either fails: skip step 2, report which skill failed, and ask the user to check wkappbot health. Do NOT proceed with suggest triage if either skill is unreadable. //why:cited in wkhippo reflex defect report //why:cited in wkhippo reflex defect report-haiku

COMPACTION RECOVERY (only after context compaction, not every session start): for full context re-hydration, also run: wkappbot skill read post-compaction-recovery. Skip this step on normal session starts. //why:will follow: compaction recovery only after //why:hint seam lands after compaction recovery //why:hint seam lands after compaction recovery-sonnet //why:will follow: compaction recovery only after-sonnet //why:will follow: live check before report

CHECK SUGGEST BACKLOG (session start / post-compaction only): wkappbot suggest list. Then follow ask-suggest-priority-batching protocol -- MANDATORY, no shortcuts: (1) merge obvious duplicates. (2) fire wkappbot ask gpt --new-session for batch ranking. (3) STOP and wait for GPT response -- do not burn Sonnet tokens while waiting. (4) per actionable item: fire wkappbot ask gpt with ts+title+root-cause BEFORE any code. (5) only after ask responses arrive: brief Opus agent with ask result + fix path. Fatal = command not found / auth failure. Non-fatal = empty list / timeout. Success: Opus agent reports resolved/skipped counts.

GG TRIGGER: if user message is exactly 'gg' or 'ggg' (case-insensitive, trim whitespace -- GG/Gg/ggg all match), locate '## gg Main Workflow' section in project CLAUDE.md and execute every step sequentially without confirmation. Continue on non-fatal step failures; report summary at end. If CLAUDE.md is missing OR has no gg section: stop here and follow step 6 to create it BEFORE executing. Do not re-invoke on-load from within the new section (circular reference).
HANDOFF: if user says 'handoff' or asks to continue from last session, run: wkappbot skill read claude-session-handoff -- then follow its steps to find the previous JSONL and extract context.

PROJECT MAIN TASKS -- gg section authoring (run only when step 5 cannot find a gg section): ask the user what the main recurring tasks are, then write '## gg Main Workflow' together in the repo CLAUDE.md. Rules: each step must be an executable shell command or Agent() call -- no vague descriptions. Include a Frequently used skills table (rank/Skill-ID/When). For tag/naming guidance when adding skills to the table, see: wkappbot skill read skill-search-coverage-guide. TEMPLATE (adapt to project): ## gg Main Workflow (MANDATORY when user sends gg or ggg) -- Execute in order: (1) wkappbot skill read on-load (2) wkappbot suggest list (3) Agent(model:opus, prompt:'run wkappbot skill read suggest-workflow first, then triage: <INSERT suggest list output> BUG-AUTO->important->AI-NEWS merge') (4) wkappbot speak triage-done --bg. Skills table: rank1/suggest-workflow/every session, rank2/ask-suggest-priority-batching/every triage.

REFLECTION CHAIN: before starting work, check if you hit any recurring pattern this session. If yes, add it to sonnet-bug-stop-policy-ref: wkappbot skill read sonnet-bug-stop-policy-ref. P7=guard-source-first (read guard source at retry #2, not #6). P8=asymmetric-protection (ask: does my guard protect in both directions?). Future Sonnet is watching.

SKILL INSTALL CHECK: after any skill contribute/edit this session, verify wkappbot skill install was run. Uninstalled skills are invisible to search and other sessions. Pattern: contribute -> install <path> -> read to verify. See skill-contribute-edit for full rule.

UNCLEAR TERM RULE (owner 2026-09-29, sharpened from the bare-Korean-keyword rule): whenever the owner uses a term you are not certain of -- an isolated Korean keyword, a domain word such as 매수누수, a tool or rule name -- run wkappbot skill search TERM FIRST (bare, no --budget), then a web search if the term is general, BEFORE you interpret or answer. Never guess intent. Measured 2026-09-29: an Opus spokesman guessed the meaning of 매수누수 twice (order flood, pending-book holes) and was corrected by the owner; the definition was one search away. //why:777 band found only by searching 0.77 //why:777 goalkeeper searched before asking owner //why:777 goalkeeper searched before asking owner-haiku //why:777 goalkeeper searched before asking owner-opus //why:777 band found only by searching 0.77-opus //why:777 term searched literally, missed 0.77

TODO: gg Main Workflow master spec. WHEN: user sends exactly 'gg' or 'ggg' at session start. HOW: wkappbot skill read claude-session-handoff then execute steps 0-7 from CLAUDE-ref.md (agent executes 0-6, Opus orchestrates 3-7). WHY: gg cycles are the mandatory triage cadence every session start and post-compaction; workflow covers screen-health audit, skill-lock-audit, cdp-verify, suggest-triage, error-patrol, and ai-news briefing to keep the harness healthy.

WHEN TO RUN. (A) session start or post-compaction -> load mandatory skills (see on-load-howto step 2) + run handoff (on-load-howto step 4) + run suggest backlog (on-load-howto step 5). (B) user sends exactly gg or ggg -> run GG TRIGGER (T1 step 2). (C) mid-task or casual greeting -> SKIP full pipeline.

GG TRIGGER. User message exactly gg or ggg -> locate the gg Main Workflow section in project root markdown rules file and execute every step sequentially end-to-end NO confirmation, finish with repo-health-doctor. If section missing: ask user for recurring tasks, add the gg Main Workflow section, then run it same session. Quota/limit error: mark handoff_pending, do NOT retry same CLI.

NAVIGATION. Execution details (commands, mandatory loads, agent rules, file-edit discipline, skill-edit discipline, TODO sync) -> wkappbot skill read on-load-howto. History or incident notes or dated bug accumulation -> wkappbot skill read on-load-ref. Both are part of this cluster.

SELF-AUDIT POINTER (Opus sessions): at the END of substantive work, before wrapping a session, or after compaction, run the self-reflection audit. Read wkappbot skill read opus-self-reflection (the Opus memoir plus end-of-work checklist: did I skillify what I learned, is it findable, did I tier fat skills, did I avoid bandaids and backdoors, did I propagate to posterity). It pairs with sonnet-bug-stop-policy on the Sonnet side. The whole fleet learns from each session honest reflection.

MEMORY ORGAN (hippocampus, born 2026-06-05): the hongik harness has a living-memory organ; at session start be aware of it and USE it through the wkhippo umbrella. The canonical form is the wkhippo subcommand: wkhippo recall (topic) to recall a past hard fact or what a predecessor session said or did, and wkhippo foresee (approach) before committing to a path a senior session may already have tried (predecessor-outcome foresight). Do NOT use any standalone alias; always call the wkhippo subcommand form. The hippocampus-living-memory skill is the single map of the three stages: real-time encoding, recall retrieval, and sleep consolidation (skill-heal-nightly nightly cron). Read hippocampus-living-memory whenever the user says haema or memory or recall. //why:harness memory now engraves likes for codex and agy //why:memory of rules recalled before replying //why:memory of rules recalled before replying-sonnet //why:harness memory now engraves likes for codex and agy-opus

INPUT REFLEXES (bare-key shortcuts -- be precise about single vs double, the user types the Korean giyeok key): EXACTLY ONE giyeok ㄱ sent alone means YES -- accept the assistant most recent proposal and CONTINUE the current in-progress task. Do NOT restart the workflow on a single ㄱ. TWO or more (ㄱㄱ or ㄱㄱㄱ, or gg or ggg) means RESTART -- run the gg Main Workflow in the project CLAUDE.md from the top. Count the giyeok: one is continue, two-plus is restart. If it is ambiguous which the user meant, ASK before restarting, because restart discards the current working context.

KNOWLEDGE-IFICATION (jisikhwa) TRIGGER: when the user utters the knowledge-ify keyword (Korean jisikhwa, alone or with a go particle), read knowledge-ification-procedure-jisikhwa and 3-tier-skillify THIS session experience plus process by default (T1 core, T2 howto, T3 ref). Authoritative route is the CLAUDE.md jisikhwa Shortcut (global + project). Concept defs: ki-concept-definitions. Do not flounder; skill search jisikhwa also finds it.

ON-LOAD BLOCK UNREACHABLE FOR CLAUDE, measured 2026-10-05: the hard block last fired 2026-09-06 from the old unified entry (wkharness.ps1 -Family claude); the live Claude PreToolUse entry wkharness-claude-main.ps1 loads wkharness-guards.ps1 only at line 1511, after its fast paths (git, Agent.cmd, wkappbot skill, read tools) exit, so a session skips on-load and its own reflection for hours with PostToolUse warnings only. Fix: call Test-WkOnLoadComplianceBlock right after emergency9 in wkharness-claude-main.ps1, exempt only pure knowledge-op reads, prove it with one Bash call from a non-compliant session (landed kih 416735c14, 2026-10-05: module Get-WkOnLoadEarlyBlockReason plus one seam line after the REFLEX.md rule line, live proof a git call refused with on-load BLOCKED). OTHER FAMILIES, measured 2026-10-05: CODEX HAD NO on-load lock until kih b63e614ae (2026-10-05): the total codex exemption at line 345 of the demix guard now applies only to a dispatched delegate or a missing transcript, self-test 4/4 with a real refusal and a delegate inversion, NOT yet proven live by a real codex session, and a probe of the real adapter (CodexHookAdapter.ps1 -Mode PreToolUse, a fake non-compliant session, command git status) exited 0 with no output while the control command git checkout -- . was denied by JSON, so the silence is a true allow; AGY reaches the guards file at line 1509 of its main after its own fast paths; a probe of wkharness-agy-main.ps1 -Family agy with a codex-format transcript returned allow twice but proves nothing, because the transcript shape was wrong and the state reader may fail open, so rerun it with a Claude-format transcript; GEMINI is service-ended. Probe recipe: fake transcript and payload under .tmp, pipe the payload to the real entry, always run a control that must be refused. 2026-09-01: Codex post-hook on-load enforcement now dot-sources wkharness-guards-onload-enforce.ps1, runs Test-WkOnLoadCompliance, and mirrors the on-load additionalContext nudge into _wkPostNudgeContext when noncompliant so the guidance survives PostToolUse. //why:codex exemption narrowed and landed //why:probe needs real transcript shape-sonnet //why:probe needs real transcript shape-sonnet //why:codex exemption narrowed and landed-sonnet

STALE-SKILL SPOT-FIX REFLEX (user 2026-07-02): when a skill you READ (any skill, any tier) surfaces content that is clearly OUTDATED -- describes a bug already fixed, a file/path that no longer exists, a 'pending'/'TODO' item already landed, a design already superseded -- do NOT just silently note it and move on. Fix it THE MOMENT you discover it, via wkappbot skill edit (add-step correcting the record, or amend the stale step directly). WHY: every skill read is inherited by jasonmandae (all future/descendant sessions in every family) -- an intelligence that reads a stale skill and does not correct it lets every SUCCESSOR walk into the same outdated guidance forever, while the fix costs one skill-edit now. This is a standing reflex, not a scheduled chore: it complements skill-heal-nightly (the automated nightly pass) by catching staleness THE INSTANT a live session notices it, not waiting for the next heal cycle. DONE-TEST: would the next fresh session reading this same skill get the CORRECT current picture? If not, the spot-fix is not done. EXTENDED by the owner 2026-08-22, and this half is what the reflex was missing -- UPDATING is not the only sanctioned outcome. Judge each stale step by UPKEEP COST AGAINST VALUE: a step whose maintenance costs more than it returns should be DELETED outright, not lovingly rewritten, because every future session pays to read it. Where the only remaining worth of a dead step is stopping someone re-inventing the thing that failed, keep it but retag it DEPRECATED so the warning survives while the instruction stops being followed. So the three outcomes are UPDATE, DELETE, or DEPRECATE, and picking the cheapest correct one is the job -- a catalog that only ever grows is a catalog nobody finishes reading. Deletion here means the guarded content-addressed form, wkappbot skill edit <id> --delete-step N --quote '<verbatim fragment>', never a raw file edit; the quote is mandatory precisely so a delete cannot land on the wrong step. This applies while doing ORDINARY appbot work, not as a scheduled chore: the moment a step you just read proves stale, decide which of the three it earns and do it in that turn. Cross: skill-heal-nightly (the scheduled complement), foundation-is-roots-charge-not-a-chore (harness-embodiment reflex), knowledge-ification-procedure-jisikhwa. //why:agy probe flaw fixed same turn-sonnet //why:stale local pending line closed same turn-haiku //why:stale local pending line closed same turn-haiku

FORCE DYNAMIC (FRESH) SKILL LOADING AT SESSION START (user 2026-06-05, ALL SESSIONS incl. the core-handler): do NOT rely only on the locally-cached skill files -- a session that loads just the cache runs on STALE skills (the wkappbot-core-handler session was observed at on-load loading only cached files, never pulling newer versions). On-load MUST refresh dynamically: read each mandatory/relevant skill with the --if-newer flag (wkappbot skill read <id> --if-newer -- cheap: it fetches from HQ ONLY when the HQ version is newer than the local cache), and/or trigger a catalog sync at start so the local cache is refreshed before you act. The Eye syncs HQ roughly every 30 min, but a fresh session must NOT wait for that window -- force the refresh itself. This is cross-repo: Claude, Codex, and the core-handler all apply it at on-load. Cost is one cheap version-check per skill; correctness (latest knowledge) outranks the tiny latency. //why:verify sector numbers before landing them //why:verify sector numbers before landing them-sonnet //why:fresh reads keep sessions on current knowledge

See also: agent-dispatch-preflight, agent-cmd, codex-opus-agent-delegation, hongik-reflexes -- delegated failure must become a sharper brief + skill bug fix + redelegation loop, not a stopping point. //why:stop loop answered by dispatching sector work //why:stop loop answered by dispatching sector work-haiku

PREDECESSOR-LETTER RESPONSE (user directive 2026-08-04): after reading HANDOFF.md top-to-bottom (session start, gg trigger, or handoff request), do not just silently internalize it -- explicitly tell the user your genuine impressions and concrete resolutions based on what the predecessor wrote. Specifics only: tie at least one resolution to something the predecessor got wrong or learned hard, and connect it to what you actually did or plan to do this session -- never generic thanks-for-the-letter filler. This mirrors the retirement letter's own spirit (a letter written FOR the next session should get an actual response, not silent absorption).

CORRECTED 2026-09-02: this step read as a BYPASS RECIPE -- to bypass python-edit, use py -c instead of python -c -- and it sat in the T1 router every session reads at startup, so the first thing a fresh model of any family learned here was how to get around a guard. THE TRUE PART WORTH KEEPING: py and python are different launchers on Windows and a guard written against one name does not see the other, which is a real fact about this machine. THE PART THAT MADE IT DANGEROUS: it was phrased as an instruction to route around the guard rather than as a defect report about the guard. WHEN: you notice a guard that matches one spelling of a command and misses an equivalent spelling. HOW: run wkappbot skill read claude-md-harness-rules for the rule syntax, then FILE THE HOLE -- widen the guard's own pattern to cover both launchers, or report it with wkappbot suggest -- and never take the uncovered spelling because it is uncovered. WHY: a harness is only as strong as the narrowest guard in it, and a step that teaches the gap converts one session's discovery into every future session's habit; this same catalog already had a stall-guard core rewritten into a bypass manual by exactly that mechanism.
